actualInspectionScope: Directly viewed only the supplied Home 1440px and Portfolio 375px full-page screenshots, from header through footer, using view_image.

Checked visible CSS styling, typography appearance, rendered interface icons and brand/showcase images, desktop card alignment, mobile single-column layout, disclosure summaries, CTAs and gross clipping/overlap.
No repository or original image modifications; no Python, browser, build, server or network checks were run for this visual review.

findings.observation: The page is visibly styled with the established colors, typography hierarchy, spacing and card layout. Header/hero/footer brand marks, service icons, action icons and all three featured showcase images render. No major blank asset area, unstyled layout, overlapping content or severe clipping is visible.

The mobile header, hero brand image and all six brand showcase previews render. Cards, badges, stacked actions, collapsed template/Planned summaries, technology cards and footer remain within the visible single-column layout. No major overflow, clipped section, overlapping controls or broken-image placeholder is visible.

limitations: The viewer downscaled the very tall full-page images to 1098x6000 and 173x6000 respectively. This was a layout/resource-appearance check, not character-by-character or pixel-level inspection.

A screenshot shows the rendered typography appearance but cannot establish exact font files, HTTP status, asset URL correctness, metadata values or byte-for-byte design equivalence; those require the separate Root evidence.
No other pages, viewports, expanded disclosure/menu states, focus/interaction states or full accessibility assessment were reviewed. No axe or complete a11y claim is made.
